sections.text: مقدمة

This document outlines the 
cooling water pump inspection steps I1, which must be carried out every six months 
as indicated by M6 in the title block

البيانات الفنية للمضخة:
Type: centrifugal pump multi stage 
RPM 2970
Manufacture: Ensival
No of stage 1 
Power 15 KW
Suction press. 1.5 bar 
Max. flow 75m3./h
Discharge press. 5 bar

The first draft initiated and 
reviewed by eng. 
Khamis El Sherif, approved by eng. Samir Ebed Barghous maintenance general 
manager, accepted by eng. Mahmoud Saad Balegh Head Sector of El Mahmoudia Power 
Plant, certified by eng Mona Ahmed El Sharqawy WDEPC MPIS coordinator, 
inspection, quality control head sector
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category

Use safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety 
and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, gloves, ... etc.
Shut down the pump
Disconnect the power supply & rack out the circuit breaker
Put red tag on the pump

Close the shut-off valves in the (suction & discharge & balancing & min flow) 
 (VG 1GREOKEB5AA1)

Let the pumps cool down to about < 80C measured 
 at the branches, then seal off the cooling water pipes and close all other 
 supply lines

Loosen all auxiliary lines, such as circulation, 
 cooling liquid, lube oil

The safety department must check the isolation 
 and surrounding the zone of work

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه
Dismantling and Reassembling
Remove coupling spacer
Drain the oil / change oil
Remove the casing adapter nuts

Pull out the complete bearing housing with rotor and carry it 
eventually to the workshop to continue dismantling

It is recommended to replace all the gaskets and o-rings at every 
reassembling

sections.text: خطوات الاختبار
Make sure that the direction of the rotation

If the pump has been filled with a cold liquid (temperature below 
60 c) it can be started at any time
At firs starting tighten the gland nut by hand
After 10 min operation tighten each nut one sixth of turn

sections.text: استبدال التعبئة
Cut off electric supply
Close isolating valve
Remove the old packing
Check if the shaft sleeve is not damaged
Clean carefully the stuffing box, the sleeve and the gland
Cut the new packing ring

Insert the rings into the stuffing box and compress them evenly 
one after each other until it is completely packed
Slightly tighten gland nuts by hand.
